content: Letter 36, to Khwāja Tāj al-Dīn Ḥasan ʿAṭṭār, the prominent Naqshbandī Sufi (successor line of Bahāʾ al-Dīn Naqshband per MK's footnote): a letter of greeting in eulogy of his spiritual stature and skill as shaykh, with a postscript to his disciples and khanaqah residents and the author's longing to visit (TMN/M f. 51b, TMN/MS p. 29, TMN/D pp. 206-7; edition in P.2.1).
